chemistry-killer-04.title: Pa 25 °C, ku
chemistry-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-04.material:
Pa 25 °C, ku 50 mL ye 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ kunowedzerwa v mL ye $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ isingazivikanwi kusimba kwayo, uye tembiricha yepamusoro yesanganiswa inoyerwa. Zvose zviri zviviri solutions dziri pa 20.0 °C pamberi pekusanganisa.
Vhoriyamu yeHCl, v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Tembiricha yepamusoro mushure mekusanganisa (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Tora kuti sanganiswa ine density 1.0 g/mL ne specific heat 4.0 J/(g·°C), mavhoriyamu anowedzerwa, uye hapana kupisa kunorasika. Reaction ndi $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo kusimba kwe HCl(aq) nekupisa kweneutralization (kupisa kunoburitswa pa 1 mol yemvura yakaumbwa, kJ/mol), nenzira iyoyo?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
Pa 25 °C, ku 50 mL ye 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ kunowedzerwa v mL ye $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ isingazivikanwi kusimba kwayo, uye tembiricha yepamusoro yesanganiswa inoyerwa. Zvose zviri zviviri solutions dziri pa 20.0 °C pamberi pekusanganisa.
Vhoriyamu yeHCl, v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Tembiricha yepamusoro mushure mekusanganisa (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Tora kuti sanganiswa ine density 1.0 g/mL ne specific heat 4.0 J/(g·°C), mavhoriyamu anowedzerwa, uye hapana kupisa kunorasika. Reaction ndi $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo kusimba kwe HCl(aq) nekupisa kweneutralization (kupisa kunoburitswa pa 1 mol yemvura yakaumbwa, kJ/mol), nenzira iyoyo?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Tembiricha inokwira ne v, inosvika pamusoro pa 29.0 °C pa 25 mL, wobva wadzika sezvo solution isina kupindura inounganidzwa (uye huwandu hwevhoriyamu huchikura). Saka pa 25 mL, H+ neOH- zvinopindura chaizvo.
Nhanho 2: NaOH = 1.0 M x 0.050 L = 0.050 mol inopindura 1:1 neHCl, saka 0.050 mol yeHCl iri mu 25 mL: 0.050 / 0.025 = 2.0 M.
Nhanho 3: Q = mcΔT = (50 + 25 mL x 1.0 g/mL) x 4.0 x 9.0 = 75 x 4.0 x 9.0 = 2700 J.
Nhanho 4: Kupisa kweneutralization = 2700 J / 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Cheka: pa v = 10 mL, 0.020 mol yeH+ inopindura, ΔT = 0.020 x 54000 / (60 x 4.0) = 4.5, saka 24.5 °C. Pa 40 mL, 0.050 mol yeOH- inopindura, ΔT = 2700 / (90 x 4.0) = 7.5, saka 27.5 °C.
Pindura: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: 36 kJ/mol inoshandisa huremu hwe 50 g; 108 kJ/mol inoshandisa 0.025 mol yemvura.)
